description: List tickets, newest activity first, with optional filters and HappyFox's search syntax. Paginated (page_info + data). Search `q` examples: `status:"New","In Progress"`, `priority:"High"`, `assignee:none`, `tag:"billing"`, `contact:"jane@example.com"`, `unresponded:true`, `breached:true`, `duedate:overdue`, `created-after:"2026/01/31"`, `last-modified-on-or-after:"2026/09/01"`, `"Custom Field":"value"`. Separate several filters with a space. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

category.description: Only tickets in this category id (happyfox_list_categories).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. id,display_id,subject,status — keeps responses small.

minify_response.description: If true, return only ticket ids.

sort.description: Sort key, e.g. created (newest first), createa, updated, due, priorityd.

status.description: `_all` (default), `_pending` (every pending-behaviour status), or a status id from happyfox_list_statuses.

name: happyfox_list_tickets
title: List or search tickets
